scope: The first complete browser vertical slice: same-origin React runtime, registration/login/logout/session expiry, authoritative balances, account history, customer-safe immutable transaction detail, responsive behavior and authenticated accessibility. Later transfer/payment, schedule/webhook and administrator interfaces remain later P08 slices.

requirements.statement: Registration, login, logout, bootstrap and expired-session behavior use the real cookie/CSRF API and never persist authentication or CSRF material in browser storage.
The customer dashboard renders real posted, reserved and available minor-unit balances with currency, version and update time and never fabricates metrics.

Account history is deterministically paginated and transaction detail exposes only the selected owner's economic lines and immutable references without counterparty balances or unrelated journal data.
A newly registered customer begins without wallets or money, and a newly created wallet displays posted, reserved and available balances of exactly zero.
Loading, empty, validation, authentication-expiry and temporary dependency failure states are explicit and do not falsely display a financial result.
Critical authenticated flows are keyboard-operable, use semantic names and non-color-only status, pass axe WCAG A/AA checks and render at desktop, tablet and mobile reference widths.
The locked production UI is served by a non-root loopback-bound same-origin proxy with real health checks, reproducible Compose startup and an executable Chromium CI gate.
